Reviewed the 240 current-bank statements against their individual rationales, agreement wording, source scope and implemented-versus-proposed policy status. Corrected compulsory military questionnaires versus actual voluntary service (Military06), post-study route versus automatic permanent residence (Immigration12), and generally negotiated wages versus the wage floor (Planning13). Added direct mining-rights, treaty-withdrawal, equal-product-taxation and migrant-benefit evidence. Additional research resolved cultivated meat as conditional support using the active June 2026 Biotech4Proteins programme and its lifecycle-assessment/commercialisation conditions. CultureNature02 and 10 remain unknown: neither cross-national IQ comparisons nor biological primacy in immediate moral intuitions can be inferred from generic equality or civic programmes. CultureNature05 is substantive interaction based on federal guidance explicitly linking interests to maturation, abilities, opportunity and experience. Reviewed all Neutral answers as mixed legal regimes or explicit developmental interactions. Healthy brain-enhancement answers remain moderate regulatory inferences rather than assertions of a dedicated statute; Indigenous ceremonial recognition is an identified inference from autochthonous minority recognition. Current-government sources are corroborated by Associated Press, Freedom House and Human Rights Watch. Verified Commons File page creator/public-domain status and visually inspected the 960x576 PNG (741 bytes). No scores targeted or other-country answers copied. Parent handles separate independent review, shared image credit, archive and generation; not ready to archive while two questions remain unsupported. Final profiles validate country germany run: four errors, all generated by the two intentionally unresolved CultureNature02/10 answers; warnings for Neutral counts in immigration (5), public/private (5), progressive/traditionalist (6), and culture/nature (5), all examined as substantive mixtures. Validator returned no neighbours because the draft remains incomplete. Additional parent research check, 2026-10-04, Codex: targeted official education and civic-information searches did not resolve Culture/Nature 02 or 10. General intelligence development, individual heritability, philosophical discussion prompts and teaching moral norms do not establish an incumbent institutional comparison of national IQ causes or immediate moral intuitions. No answer changed and no publication sign-off is implied. Focused continuation on 2026-10-05 by primary OpenAI Codex agent /root: Reread BIÖG developmental guidance (18 March 2026), which describes interaction of inherited predispositions, maturation and experience. This concerns individuals, not national IQ comparisons. Read the bpb fluter issue 17 interview with Otfried Höffe, pp.20–22: the interviewee rejects innate morality, but an attributed philosophical interview is not proof of current government adoption of that explanation for immediate moral intuitions. All 2 exact question-level gaps remain null/unknown. Existing supported answers, period and cutoff are preserved. This was a focused same-agent research and separate challenge pass, not a complete independent re-review or publication sign-off. These are most-likely provisional estimates, not adopted national causal theories. The distinction between individual and national/racial heredity, immediate intuition and deliberate instruction, and interventions and causal predominance is retained. Assumption IDs: culture-nature-02, culture-nature-10.
